findings.claim: Stored XSS: the 'Imported from' footer interpolates url unescaped into <a href='#{url}'>, and the post is created with cook_method raw_html, so the sanitizer never runs; an anonymous request with a quote-bearing embed_url on the embeddable host plants script in the forum origin.
findings.evidence: Post#cook returns raw for raw_html (app/models/post.rb:133); TopicEmbed.import passes cook_method raw_html (topic_embed.rb:22); embed_url comes from the unauthenticated param via EmbedController#best -> RetrieveTopic -> TopicRetriever, gated only by host equality and a forgeable Referer. Proposed red test: TopicEmbed.import(user, "http://eviltrout.com/?a='onmouseover='alert(1)", title, 'x'); post.cooked.should_not =~ /onmouseover/. Reasoned, not run.
findings.reason: Two independent correctness seats traced the same path; unauthenticated stored XSS.

findings.claim: raw_html cook method bypasses sanitization for all remote content: RSS item HTML (CGI.unescapeHTML only) and Readability output (keeps javascript: hrefs) are stored as cooked HTML verbatim; later edits of such posts are also cooked raw.
findings.evidence: return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]; content sources topic_embed.rb:48-50 and poll_feed.rb:35. Red test: import contents '<script>alert(1)</script>' and assert cooked has no <script>. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Whoever controls the feed (or MITMs an http feed) or the embed_by_username account controls script on the forum origin.

findings.claim: open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) uses Kernel#open, so a setting value starting with '|' runs a shell command on the server (admin -> RCE), also triggered synchronously via TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve.
findings.evidence: Kernel#open pipe semantics; open-uri only intercepts URI-looking strings. Red test: feed_polling_url = "|touch #{tmp}", run poller.execute({}), assert file absent. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Admin is not meant to imply shell access; fix is URI.parse(url).open with an http/https scheme check.

findings.claim: i.content.scrub assumes every item has <content>; SimpleRSS RSS 2.0 items normally expose only description (content:encoded maps to content_encoded), so i.content is nil and NoMethodError aborts the whole hourly run (retry: false, no per-item rescue). Fallback i.id at :33 is Atom-only (RSS uses guid).
findings.evidence: Reasoned from SimpleRSS item tag mapping (from memory, not gem source); spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb stubs poll_feed so no coverage. Red test: SimpleRSS.parse an RSS 2.0 doc with description-only items into poll_feed.
findings.reason: Three seats agree; the most common WordPress feed shape would crash every poll. Mapping is unverified against gem source - the red test settles it.

findings.claim: String#scrub does not exist on Ruby 2.0 (.travis.yml rvm 2.0.0), so feed polling raises NoMethodError on the first item.
findings.evidence: Seat cited .travis.yml and absence of a scrub gem.
findings.reason: Backport exists: lib/freedom_patches/scrub.rb, loaded for every file in lib/freedom_patches by config/initializers/02-freedom_patches.rb:1. Also noted by the mattpocock seat.

findings.claim: Anonymous requests can force unlimited outbound fetches and topic creation: every distinct embed_url on the embeddable host (?a=1, ?a=2, ...) passes the host check, enqueues RetrieveTopic, runs a full synchronous PollFeed, and creates a new topic as embed_by_username; the throttle key retrieved:#{url} is per exact URL.
findings.evidence: lib/topic_retriever.rb:9-33 and :40-41; only gate is the forgeable Referer check (embed_controller.rb:26); topic_id_for_embed matches exact URL string. Red test: two get :best with Referer=host and embed_url ...?x=1 / ...?x=2 with fetch stubbed, expect TopicEmbed.count to stay bounded. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Spam-topic creation plus work amplification reachable unauthenticated.

findings.claim: Deleting an imported post or topic breaks the embed permanently: TopicEmbed rows are never cleaned up; a missing post makes embed.post nil and PostRevisor.new(nil).revise! raise inside the feed loop; a trashed topic keeps topic_id_for_embed returning its id so TopicView raises NotFound and that page's comments 404 forever.
findings.evidence: Trashable default scope (app/models/concerns/trashable.rb:5); topic_view.rb:300 raises NotFound; no association/dependent cleanup from Topic to topic_embeds. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Normalised to Important (superpowers Important, OCR Minor): routine moderation causes a permanent 404 and a recurring job crash.

findings.claim: Disqus import regressions: --category option removed and created_at no longer preserved; each thread now does a live HTTP fetch via import_remote with no rescue so one 404 aborts the whole import; open-uri is not required by the task or topic_embed.rb; re-runs duplicate comments because import returns the existing post and the comment loop runs again.
findings.evidence: git diff of lib/tasks/disqus.thor; open-uri is required only in poll_feed.rb:7 among the new code. Reasoned.
findings.reason: Normalised to Important (OCR Important, superpowers Minor): silent behavior loss in an existing tool unrelated to the feature's stated goal.

findings.claim: New feed-import and remote-fetch paths have no tests (breach of CONTRIBUTING.md section 3, 'Include tests'): PollFeed#poll_feed is always stubbed, TopicEmbed.import_remote and absolutize_urls are never exercised, TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve/fetch_http are always mocked.
findings.evidence: spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb, spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb contents.
findings.reason: Documented repo standard; the untested paths are exactly where the Important bugs above live. Red tests from the fix round close this.

findings.claim: Patch edits an already-shipped migration to add force: true; unrelated to embedding. New create_topic_embeds migration also uses force: true and has a timestamp (20131217) older than merged migrations (20131223), so it runs out of order.
findings.evidence: git diff 62db063e1e -- db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb shows only create_table :top_topics -> create_table :top_topics, force: true.
findings.reason: Severity downgraded from Important (superpowers): Rails will not re-run a migration recorded in schema_migrations, and on a fresh database top_topics does not yet exist, so force: true drops nothing in normal operation. Still unrelated churn on a shipped migration; revert the hunk.

findings.claim: absolutize_urls mangles protocol-relative URLs: //cdn.example.com/x.png starts with '/' and is rewritten to http://host/cdn.example.com/x.png (same for a[href] at :64 and img[src] at :70).
findings.evidence: start_with?('/') check followed by sub(/^\/+/, '').
findings.reason: Breaks images/links on common feeds; one-condition fix.

findings.claim: Throttle uses setnx then expire as two calls; a crash between them leaves a non-expiring key and the URL is throttled forever.
findings.evidence: lib/topic_retriever.rb:27-28. Use SET key 1 NX EX 60.
findings.reason: Cheap atomic replacement.

findings.claim: postMessage origin check is a substring/prefix match (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin)), accepting e.g. http://forum.example.co for http://forum.example.com/.
findings.evidence: embed.js:17. Impact limited to resizing the iframe.
findings.reason: Exact origin comparison is a one-line change.

findings.claim: '<%- end if %>' typo: the if/else becomes conditional on the next buffer append and only renders because that expression is truthy.
findings.evidence: Erubis statement compilation; controller specs do not render views.
findings.reason: All four seats flagged it; should be '<%- end %>'.

findings.claim: discourse_expires_in caches via Middleware::AnonymousCache keyed only on HTTP_HOST + REQUEST_URI, so a cached response is served to any Referer for a minute without ensure_embeddable running, and the first requester's referer is baked into the cached layout as the postMessage target.
findings.evidence: lib/middleware/anonymous_cache.rb:14 per seat.
findings.reason: ponytail: single embeddable_host limits impact today; revisit if multiple embedding hosts are supported.

findings.claim: X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL is not a valid header value; it works only because browsers ignore invalid values.
findings.evidence: embed_controller.rb:28.
findings.reason: ponytail: harmless in practice; replace with CSP frame-ancestors <embeddable_host> when tightening framing.

findings.claim: request.referer is written into a JS string in the layout without JS-context escaping.
findings.evidence: Out-of-lane note from the advisory seat; not analysed by a correctness seat.
findings.reason: Unverified: settle by rendering the layout with a Referer containing a quote and </script> and checking the output; ERB HTML-escaping may or may not suffice in this JS context.

findings.claim: add_column on posts with default: 1, null: false rewrites the whole table under an exclusive lock on PostgreSQL < 11; downtime on large forums.
findings.evidence: Migration line 3.
findings.reason: ponytail: operational concern for large installs; split into add nullable column + backfill + constraint if it matters.

findings.claim: New gems (simple-rss, ruby-readability) added only to Gemfile_rails4.lock; Gemfile.lock and Gemfile_rails_master.lock not updated, so bundle install --deployment fails in those modes.
findings.evidence: grep for simple-rss/ruby-readability in Gemfile.lock and Gemfile_rails_master.lock returns nothing (verified by orchestrator).
findings.reason: Confirmed by grep.

findings.claim: 'requires feed_polling_url' and 'requires embed_by_username' pass vacuously because feed_polling_enabled defaults to false, so execute short-circuits on the first guard.
findings.evidence: config/site_settings.yml feed_polling_enabled default false; specs stub only their own setting.
findings.reason: Tests do not test what they name.

findings.claim: 'is 404 without an embed_url' passes because ensure_embeddable raises InvalidAccess (403) first; the missing-param path is never exercised.
findings.evidence: embeddable_host defaults to ''; spec asserts only should_not be_success.
findings.reason: Test passes for the wrong reason.

findings.claim: Specs stub private methods (perform_retrieve, retrieved_recently?) and the controller spec mocks TopicRetriever.new which the controller never calls directly; the redis throttle itself is never tested.
findings.evidence: spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:9-42; spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:40-46.
findings.reason: ponytail: covered by the test-gap finding's red tests; the standard cited is the user's global test philosophy, not a repo standard.

findings.claim: shoulda belong_to/validate_presence_of checks only re-test ActiveRecord declarations; poll_feed_spec requires jobs/regular/process_post without using it.
findings.evidence: spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:5-8; spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:2.
findings.reason: shoulda association/validation one-liners are the repo convention (32 files under spec/models use them). The unused process_post require in poll_feed_spec is trivial and dies with the test rewrite.

findings.claim: feed_key method and require 'digest/sha1' (line 4) are dead code.
findings.evidence: grep feed_key finds only the definition.
findings.reason: Delete.

findings.claim: PollFeed requires PostCreator/PostRevisor it never uses, while TopicEmbed (which uses them and open-uri) has no requires and works only by load order; lib/ is not autoloaded.
findings.evidence: config/application.rb autoload paths; PostCreator at topic_embed.rb:22, PostRevisor :35, open :48.
findings.reason: Move the requires (and add require 'open-uri') to topic_embed.rb; also fixes the disqus.thor open-uri gap.

findings.claim: Unused require of email/sender.
findings.evidence: No Email:: reference in the file.
findings.reason: Delete.

findings.claim: absolutize_urls duplicates the a[href]/img[src] loop, so fixes (e.g. protocol-relative) must be made twice.
findings.evidence: topic_embed.rb:62-73.
findings.reason: ponytail: fold into the protocol-relative fix only if it shrinks the diff; not worth a separate change.

findings.claim: embed.permalink locale key is unused.
findings.evidence: grep permalink in embed views/layout/controller finds nothing (verified by orchestrator).
findings.reason: Delete the key.

findings.claim: Header branch duplicates link_to differing only by i18n key.
findings.evidence: best.html.erb:2-6.
findings.reason: ponytail: style-level; the end-if fix is the one that matters.

findings.claim: opts=nil followed by opts = opts || {} (also topic_embed.rb:44,47); use opts={}. Also lacks spaces around '=' per CONTRIBUTING section 4.
findings.evidence: Both call sites pass a hash or nothing.
findings.reason: Trivial simplification.

findings.claim: Unrelated whitespace churn in a shipped migration and a removed blank line in lib/post_revisor.rb:11.
findings.evidence: git diff of those files.
findings.reason: Revert unrelated hunks so the real PostRevisor change (save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])) is visible.

findings.claim: {best: 5} lacks spaces inside braces (CONTRIBUTING section 4); same in spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:50.
findings.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md section 4.
findings.reason: Documented standard, trivial.

findings.claim: def self.method used instead of class << self, against CONTRIBUTING section 4.
findings.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md section 4.
findings.reason: CONTRIBUTING section 3 says follow existing conventions; app/models + lib contain 474 'def self.' definitions vs 11 'class << self', and post.rb:63 matches neighbours.

findings.claim: contents << mutates the caller's string argument.
findings.evidence: topic_embed.rb:13.
findings.reason: Address together with the Critical escaping fix on the same line.
